decisions.reason: As a newly launched identity-linked feature that fits the firm's secure-platform strategy and is likely inexpensive to maintain as part of the stack, it is rational to keep the option open while market learning is still limited.

The identity-bound payment wallet is strategically aligned with the firm's payments and digital-identity capabilities, so despite still-uncertain demand after launch, its upside justifies continued market presence.

The NFC tag login authenticator is more niche and its adoption is less certain than the core platform offers, but it still extends the firm's authentication portfolio enough to merit another year of observation.

A secure payment and wallet framework directly supports the firm's ecosystem and super-app positioning, and its dedicated webpage suggests enough strategic importance to continue rather than exit early.
This product is essentially at the center of the firm's stated direction toward secure multi-service super apps, so abandoning it quickly would be inconsistent with both strategy and option value.

The application shielding library leverages the firm's long-standing security expertise and can complement multiple other offers, making it sensible to retain while its commercial potential becomes clearer.
